pages.text: A beacon for any face, floor, ceiling or wall: lit, its lens **rotates** (two beams sweeping round), **flashes** twice a second (every beacon in step) or burns **steady**. Red, amber, blue, green or white: use a dye on it (red; orange or yellow for amber; blue; green; white), or choose on its screen. It lights the space round it while it is on.
A caged bulkhead lamp for any face. Dark until an alarm, or white all the time (your bunker's lights); in alarm it turns **red and flashes**, every one in step, and keeps lighting the room.
